data.title: Lights Illuminate Al-Baha's Neighborhoods and Mountain Slopes at Night
data.content:
Al-Baha, November 21, 2026, SPA -- At night, lights across the parks, gardens, and roads of Al-Baha draw lines across its neighborhoods and up its mountain slopes, with brightly lit squares outlining the city's details and rugged terrain when seen from above.
    The Al-Baha Region Municipality has recently completed a wide range of lighting projects across the city's roads, streets, parks, gardens, and squares, installing more than 10,000 poles along main roads and rural village routes. Projects include lighting King Fahd Road, which links Al-Baha in the Sarawat highlands with Al-Makhwah in the Tihama lowlands, and routes connecting the city with neighboring governorates, as well as government-planned residential areas and all village roads under the municipality's jurisdiction.
    About 95% of the city's street lighting now uses LED technology, in line with the municipality's strategy to save energy, improve efficiency, and reduce maintenance.
    With mist, light rain, colorful lights, and cooler temperatures, the city's atmosphere is drawing residents, visitors, and holidaymakers to its parks and to high vantage points to photograph the view, as the glow brings out the beauty of Al-Baha's mountain landscape at night.
    -- SPA
20:37 Local Time 17:37 GMT
